brief:
Ramallah — The Qattan Center is screening the documentary "Difficult Freedom," which examines the relationship between Palestinian citizens and their land, the Ma'an news agency reported. The film explores how Palestinians experience and maintain their connection to territory, addressing themes central to Palestinian identity and historical experience.

The screening represents part of the center's programming to engage audiences with documentary work that addresses social and political dimensions of Palestinian life. No additional details about screening dates, venue information, or supplementary events were immediately available.
title: Qattan Center screens documentary on Palestinians' bond with land
